'''Maerone''' is a small [[Cairhienin]] town or large village{{ref/book|6|6}} on the east bank of the [[River Erinin]] on the border with [[Andor]]. Maerone is not an important port on the river, being dwarfed by the more important [[Aringill]] on the Andoran side. 

== Places == 

* The River Gate, the best inn
* [[The Golden Stag]], the second best inn
* The Erinin Inn
* The Fox and Goose
* The Wagoner's Whip
* The Silver Horn
* The Three Towers

== People ==

* [[Mistress Daelvin]], owner of the Golden Stag
* [[Betse Silvin]], barmaid at the Golden Stag
* [[Chel Vanin]], Andoran horse thief living there, later a member of the [[Band of the Red Hand]]
* [[Olver]], a child refugee from the civil war
* [[Catrelle Mosenain]], one of [[Daved Hanlon]]'s victims whom he impregnated and later murdered.

== Events ==

During the recent civil war in Cairhien, many thousands of refugees from Cairhien attempted to cross into Andor via Maerone and Aringill, leading to some difficulties for the government of Andor. During this time, the town was not under the control of any nation, being stuck half-way and filled with people of all nations. The [[White Lions]] of Andor flew their flag above the town walls and attempted to control the refugee situation.{{ref/book|6|6}}

Later, during preperations for the [[Dragon Reborn]]'s assault on [[Illian]], [[Mat Cauthon]] led the [[Band of the Red Hand]] southwards from the town and hired supply ships there. It was in Maerone that Mat befriended [[Olver]], who subsequently was 'adopted' by the Band.
